title: Airman jumps into water, saves man from sinking car after crash
description: U.S. Air Force 1st Lt. Paul Dangelo and Champaign County Deputy Christopher Culler jumped into a pond to save a man from a sinking vehicle after a collision near Springfield, Ohio on May 31, 2024. The two men risked their lives pulling an injured man out of a completely submerged vehicle, going above and beyond their call of duty. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Airman 1st Class Josh Kaeser)
